description: Election Commission - Degree Awarding Institute Order- Bachelor of Science Honours In Medical and Health Product Management CINEC Campus (Pvt) Ltd.
categorisation: This gazette contains an order made under Section 25A of the Universities Act No. 16 of 1978, which constitutes a legal/regulatory action. It amends a previous gazette notification (No. 2268/90) by adding a new degree program to Schedule II of the order, subject to specific conditions outlined in Schedule I. This represents the exercise of statutory powers to modify regulatory frameworks governing higher education institutions, falling squarely within legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
